snippet.title: Mira and the Legend of the Djinns - Official Update Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Join the development team at Little Knight Games for an update on Mira and the Legend of the Djinns in this latest trailer for the upcoming D pixel art style Metroidvania, inspired by Moroccan culture and spiritual traditions. The team shares an update on what they've been working on, including bosses, combat, expanding the game's world, and more. Mira and the Legend of the Djinns will be available on PC in 2025.
